# Labels below follow the Rhode Island Hospital Discharge Data dictionary
# (HDD2015-18cy6-20-19, revised 6/20/2019). Unknown codes stay visible.
label_from_dictionary <- function(x, codebook, field) {
  code <- trimws(as.character(x))
  key <- toupper(code)
  numeric_code <- !is.na(code) & grepl("^[0-9]+$", code)
  key[numeric_code] <- as.character(as.integer(code[numeric_code]))
  label <- unname(codebook[key])
  missing <- is.na(code) | code == "" | code %in% c(".A", ".")
  unknown <- !missing & is.na(label)
  label[missing] <- "Missing / unknown"
  label[unknown] <- paste0("Not listed in data dictionary (", field, " code ", code[unknown], ")")
  label
}

labelled_factor <- function(x, codebook, field) {
  labels <- label_from_dictionary(x, codebook, field)
  levels <- unique(c(unname(codebook), setdiff(unique(labels), unname(codebook))))
  factor(labels, levels = levels)
}

# Part 3



```{r, include=FALSE}
## Setup
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(randomForest)

set.seed(123)
```



```{r, include=FALSE}
## Question 1
# Select variables and remove missing values
df3 <- dfN %>%
  select(tot, age, sex, raceethn, provider, moa,
         mod, admtype, campus, los) %>%
  filter(raceethn != "", admtype != "") %>%
  mutate(
    age = as.numeric(age),
    los = as.numeric(los),
    tot = as.numeric(tot)
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

# Create target
med <- median(df3$tot)

df3 <- df3 %>%
  mutate(target = factor(ifelse(tot < med, "low", "high"))) %>%
  select(-tot)

# Convert categorical variables to factors
df3 <- df3 %>%
  mutate(across(c(sex, raceethn, provider, moa,
                  mod, admtype, campus), as.factor))

# Training 10%, Testing 90%
set.seed(123)

index <- createDataPartition(df3$target, p = 0.10, list = FALSE)

train1 <- df3[index, ]
test1 <- df3[-index, ]

nrow(train1)
nrow(test1)
table(train1$target)
```



```{r, include=FALSE}
## Question 2
# Decision tree
tree1 <- rpart(target ~ ., data = train1,
               method = "class",
               control = rpart.control(minsplit = 2, cp = 0.001))

rpart.plot(tree1)

# Variable importance
if (!is.null(tree1$variable.importance)) {
  barplot(sort(tree1$variable.importance),
          horiz = TRUE,
          las = 1,
          col = "steelblue",
          main = "Variable Importance")
} else {
  print("Tree has no splits.")
}
```



```{r, include=FALSE}
## Question 3
# 5-fold cross-validation
control <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5)

# Decision tree
set.seed(123)

model1 <- train(
  target ~ .,
  data = train1,
  method = "rpart",
  trControl = control,
  tuneGrid = data.frame(cp = c(0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1)),
  control = rpart.control(minsplit = 2, xval = 0)
)

# Random forest2
set.seed(123)

model2 <- train(
  target ~ .,
  data = train1,
  method = "rf",
  trControl = control,
  tuneGrid = data.frame(mtry = c(1, 2, 3)),
  ntree = 100
)

# Results
model1
model2

# Tuning plots
plot(model1)
plot(model2)
```

## Question 4

```{r}
# Compare models
comparison <- resamples(list(Tree = model1, Forest = model2))

summary(comparison)

dotplot(comparison, metric = "Accuracy")
```

## Question 5

```{r}
# Compare accuracy
accuracy1 <- max(model1$results$Accuracy)
accuracy2 <- max(model2$results$Accuracy)

accuracy1
accuracy2

# Select best model
if (accuracy1 >= accuracy2) {
  final_model <- model1
} else {
  final_model <- model2
}

final_model

# Test predictions
pred <- predict(final_model, test1)

confusionMatrix(pred, test1$target)

# Test accuracy
mean(pred == test1$target)
```

## Question 6 — Second Target

Predict whether a patient has a short or long hospital stay.

```{r}
# Select variables and remove missing values
df4 <- dfN %>%
  select(los, age, sex, raceethn, provider,
         moa, mod, admtype, campus) %>%
  filter(raceethn != "", admtype != "") %>%
  mutate(
    age = as.numeric(age),
    los = as.numeric(los)
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

# Create target
med2 <- median(df4$los)

df4 <- df4 %>%
  mutate(target = factor(ifelse(los > med2, "long", "short"))) %>%
  select(-los)

# Convert categorical variables
df4 <- df4 %>%
  mutate(across(c(sex, raceethn, provider, moa,
                  mod, admtype, campus), as.factor))

# Training 10%, Testing 90%
set.seed(123)

index2 <- createDataPartition(df4$target, p = 0.10, list = FALSE)

train2 <- df4[index2, ]
test2 <- df4[-index2, ]

nrow(train2)
nrow(test2)
table(train2$target)
```

### Question 6 — Decision Tree

```{r}
tree2 <- rpart(target ~ ., data = train2,
               method = "class",
               control = rpart.control(minsplit = 2, cp = 0.001))

rpart.plot(tree2)

# Variable importance
if (!is.null(tree2$variable.importance)) {
  barplot(sort(tree2$variable.importance),
          horiz = TRUE,
          las = 1,
          col = "steelblue",
          main = "Variable Importance")
} else {
  print("Tree has no splits.")
}
```

### Question 6 — Train and Tune Models

```{r}
# Decision tree
set.seed(123)

model3 <- train(
  target ~ .,
  data = train2,
  method = "rpart",
  trControl = control,
  tuneGrid = data.frame(cp = c(0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1)),
  control = rpart.control(minsplit = 2, xval = 0)
)

# Random forest
set.seed(123)

model4 <- train(
  target ~ .,
  data = train2,
  method = "rf",
  trControl = control,
  tuneGrid = data.frame(mtry = c(1, 2, 3)),
  ntree = 100
)

# Results
model3
model4

# Tuning plots
plot(model3)
plot(model4)
```

### Question 6 — Compare Models

```{r}
comparison2 <- resamples(list(Tree = model3, Forest = model4))

summary(comparison2)

dotplot(comparison2, metric = "Accuracy")
```

### Question 6 — Final Model

```{r}
# Compare accuracy
accuracy3 <- max(model3$results$Accuracy)
accuracy4 <- max(model4$results$Accuracy)

accuracy3
accuracy4

# Select best model
if (accuracy3 >= accuracy4) {
  final_model2 <- model3
} else {
  final_model2 <- model4
}

final_model2

# Test predictions
pred2 <- predict(final_model2, test2)

confusionMatrix(pred2, test2$target)

# Test accuracy
mean(pred2 == test2$target)
```
